But healthy compared to what? The network is healthy. All indicators are green. The alarms are silent. But healthy compared to what? What is normal today is not what was normal then. And no one noticed when it changed. Diagnostics and monitoring provide the visibility needed to detect operational drift before it becomes failure. They reveal the difference between green and right. What Is Network Diagnostics & Monitoring? Diagnostics and monitoring provide the visibility needed to understand network behaviour, detect drift, and preserve forensic evidence. Monitoring tells you what is happening. Diagnostics tell you why. Together, they transform the network from an opaque system into an observable, understandable, and manageable asset.
